get.summary: Get exact sermon archive counts and optional query match counts
get.description: Use first for exact archive, source, chunk, status, embedding, and topic counts. Use scriptureStats for Bible-book counts and queryStats for broader searches.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional topic, passage, phrase, Bible book, or series term to count across sermons, sources, and chunks.

parameters.name: scriptureBook
parameters.description: Optional Bible book name, such as James, Romans, or Psalms. This is treated as a count/search filter.

post.summary: Create a lossless sermon-development walk session
post.description: Starts an append-only sermon walk capture and returns a scoped mobile launch URL. The walk app durably records audio, exact transcript turns, save receipts, and an integrity manifest before the session can close.

201.description: Sermon walk session and scoped launch URL created

post.summary: Create a backend-selected sermon manuscript DOCX draft
post.description: Server-side workflow that selects the right sermon source layers from a compact manifest, generates a refined manuscript, saves it as source material, returns a downloadable DOCX export, and marks it as the primary future-preaching manuscript.

dryRun.description: When true, returns backend source-selection stats and skips manuscript writing and DOCX export.

runAiSelectionInDryRun.description: When dryRun is true, set this true only if AI source selection should be tested. Otherwise dryRun uses deterministic backend selection.

targetLength.description: Desired manuscript length, such as full sermon manuscript or 3500 words.

focusNotes.description: Dan's extra direction for this draft.

manuscriptFormat.description: Optional custom format instructions. Omit to use Dan's standard preaching manuscript format.

includeSourceMaterial.description: Deprecated for this endpoint; source material is selected and hydrated server-side.

sourceLimit.description: Maximum source summaries to consider in the backend selection manifest.

maxSelectedSources.description: Maximum full source records the backend should hydrate for manuscript generation after selection.

useAiSourceSelection.description: When false, use deterministic backend source selection only.

sourceMaterialBudget.description: Character budget for selected source material included in the server-side manuscript prompt.

model.description: Optional override for the backend manuscript generation model. Omit to use the server default.

seriesId.description: Stable series id, for example series-james-living-our-faith.

seriesTitle.description: Human-readable series title, for example James — Living Our Faith.

seriesSlug.description: Stable series slug, for example james-living-our-faith.

seriesNumber.description: Message number within the series when known.

tags.description: Searchable metadata tags such as james, mercy, wednesday-evening, old-chat.

manuscriptMode.description: Use assembly when Dan wants the manuscript assembled from supplied development material with minimal connective prose and no invented fuller sermon.

excludeGeneratedManuscriptSources.description: Generated prior manuscript drafts are excluded by default to avoid feedback-loop poisoning.

includeGeneratedManuscriptSources.description: Explicit opt-in to allow prior generated manuscript drafts as source material.

includePriorManuscriptSources.description: Alias for explicit opt-in to allow prior generated manuscript drafts as source material.

requireReliefEnding.description: In assembly mode, enforce a relief-shaped ending instead of a long instruction/application list.

requireSimpleFinalPosture.description: In assembly mode, require the simple final posture from Dan’s material when present.

get.summary: Get one sermon source material record
get.description: Retrieves the full saved source material record, including material text and references.

post.summary: Save a media transcript as sermon source material
post.description: Stores raw or cleaned transcript text as source material connected to a sermon media record.

get.summary: Get full sermon context for continuing development
get.description: Retrieves sermon hub detail plus source summaries, recent snapshots, recent preaching analyses, and preaching profile context in one call. Use before continuing sermon development when continuity matters.

parameters.name: includeSourceMaterial
parameters.description: Set true only when full saved source material text is needed. Default returns source summaries only.

parameters.name: includePreachingProfile
parameters.description: Set false to omit preaching profile context. Defaults to included.

get.summary: List generated editable PowerPoint decks for one sermon

post.summary: Create an editable 16:9 PPTX deck for a sermon, reusing the series template when available

templateId.description: Optional template override. Omit to reuse or create the active template for the sermon series.

theme.description: Optional theme override used only when the backend creates a new template.

slidePlan.description: Optional full slide plan. Omit for a backend-generated plan from sermon title, passage, big idea, and outline.

compact.description: Return only the presentation ID, template ID, slide count, and PPTX download details. Set false only when a full slide plan is required in the response.

get.summary: Search sermon source material records across the archive
get.description: Searches saved sermon source material records across all sermons. Use one short topic, phrase, passage, or keyword at a time.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Short topic, phrase, passage, or keyword to search in saved sermon source records.

get.description: Searches the sermon chunk index across sermons, source materials, and preaching analyses. This is the keyword-search foundation for later semantic/vector retrieval.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Short topic, phrase, passage, or keyword to search in indexed sermon chunks.
